title: Establishment of the Mouse Wound Healing Model and Sample Collection
author: Ke Zhang

steps.title: Prepare Mice for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize and prepare the dorsal skin of 2-month-old and 24-month-old p16-3MR mice.

substeps.instruction: Anesthetize mice with 3% isoflurane via nose cone.
Administer subcutaneous analgesia using Ethiqa XR (3.25 mg/kg, 1.3 mg/mL) 30 minutes before wounding.
Shave the dorsal area with electric clippers.
Depilate the area using chemical depilatory cream (apply for no more than 30 seconds and remove thoroughly with moist gauze).

steps.title: Create Full-Thickness Excisional Wounds
steps.instruction: Generate a single 6-mm full-thickness wound on the central dorsum.

substeps.instruction: Use a sterile biopsy punch to create a 6-mm wound including the panniculus carnosus.

steps.title: Collect Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Collect wound samples at two distinct time points.

substeps.instruction: Collect excised wound tissue at day 0.
Collect wound-edge skin at day 3 post-injury using a 6-mm punch biopsy centered at the healing margin.

steps.title: Preserve and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Embed and freeze the dissected mouse skin samples.

substeps.instruction: Place samples into OCT-containing plastic molds.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Process the frozen tissue blocks for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Cryosection the frozen OCT-embedded tissue blocks.
Use tissue sections for spatial sequencing with Raman imaging.
